name: 1:1 Check-in
description: Notes from a one-to-one: topics, feedback, support needed and agreed follow-ups.
outline: Summarize the topics in the order they were discussed, one short paragraph or a few bullets each.
Capture feedback given in either direction, worded respectfully and close to what was said.
Note anything the person asked for or needs support with.
List agreed follow-ups with owner and timing.
Mention goals or development topics only if they were discussed.
Keep it factual: never add information that is not in the transcript, and omit a section when nothing applies.
example:
## Topics
- Workload on the migration

## Follow-ups
- [ ] Review the team plan (manager, next week)
